messages:
Aisha: Quick sync on enterprise compliance MVP scope. Customers pressing for reliable audit exports, BYOK handshake, retention controls, and legal-hold. Proposing minimal launch scope:
- signed export (CSV + parquet) to S3 with manifest + checksum
- lightweight index: time / tenant / event_type only
- BYOK handshake: manual operator-assisted flow for v1 (no auto-rotation)
- retention presets (30/90/365) enforced server-side + API to set per-tenant
- legal-hold flag that prevents deletes and is recorded in audit trail

Tom (Eng): Agree keep scope tight. Full-text search and dedupe are big work. If index is limited to time/tenant/type we reduce infra & dev by weeks. Rough estimate: 2 engs x 6 wks + 1 infra for bucket/IAM templates.

Maya (Security): Must include tamper-evidence for exported bundles and signed manifests. BYOK design should use envelope encryption; need audit logs for KMS usage (who/when). Provide test vectors for rotation and compromise scenarios.

Jared (SRE): Operational notes: retention enforcement must purge both stored artifacts and any in-memory caches/KV caches. Export jobs need retry/backoff + alerting for stuck jobs. Reuse existing export job runner where possible.

Lina (Sales): Buyers want both CSV and parquet outputs + signed manifest for proof-of-delivery. Legal teams request on-demand legal-hold via API. BYOK is gating for several deals. Recommend pilot with 3 customers.

Raj (Legal): Legal hold semantics: hold supersedes retention. Exports must include chain-of-custody meta: request_id, tenant_id, export_ts, signer, checksum, retention_state, hold_flag. Add a retention-exception workflow for subpoenas.

Aisha: Proposed decisions for MVP:
- Include: S3 export (CSV/parquet), signed manifest + checksum, basic index, BYOK handshake manual, retention presets server-enforced, legal-hold override.
- Defer: full-text search, automated key rotation, SOC2 evidence automation (alpha only).

Tom (Eng): Implementation plan (owners):
- export pipeline + manifest signer (Tom)
- index service (Tom)
- retention enforcement + control-plane hooks (Jared)
- infra: bucket policies / IAM templates (Jared)
Estimate: 2 engs full-time 6w + infra.

Maya (Security): Acceptance criteria for sign-off:
1) Exports are tamper-evident (signed manifests)
2) Export integrity verification works end-to-end
3) BYOK handshake documented + manual flow validated by security tests
4) Retention enforcement proven on persisted and cached data
5) Key usage audit logs for BYOK tenants

Jared (SRE): Operational SLOs to include in launch checklist:
- export job success >= 99.9% (7d)
- export latency p95 < 5m for 1GB batches
- alert on >3 retries per job
- dashboards: latency histogram, failed job count, purge rate

Tom (Eng): Blockers: dedicated-customer bucket policies & quotas, signer key storage (platform KMS vs customer KMS), export bandwidth caps. Action: infra to PR templates for bucket policies & IAM.

Maya (Security): For manifest signer keys: use tenant KMS for BYOK; fall back to platform HSM-backed KMS. I'll draft threat model for signer key compromise and rotation guidelines.

Raj (Legal): Legal-hold acceptance: when hold=true, retention must not delete; manifests export should flag hold. Also require logs showing who set/cleared hold and timestamps.

Lina (Sales): I'll recruit 3 pilot customers (finserv, mid-market SaaS, and startup) to validate BYOK handshake and retention presets. Recommend a 4-week validation window post-merge.

Aisha: Action items (owners):
- Tom: RFC for export pipeline + sample manifest schema
- Maya: BYOK handshake diagram + threat model & test plan
- Jared: CF template PR for bucket policies + retention hooks
- Raj: legal-hold schema + exception flow doc
- Lina: list of 3 pilot candidates and intro plan
- Aisha: consolidate acceptance criteria and publish launch checklist

Tom: I can post the RFC by Thursday EOD. :thumbsup:
Maya: BYOK diagrams and test plan by Friday AM. :eyes:
Jared: Starting bucket policy template today and will open PR tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Reminder - sprint-planning kickoff in #eng-releases at 10:00am tomorrow.

Aisha: Great work. We'll reconvene after RFCs and diagrams. If we need a follow-up meeting we'll schedule. :rocket:
